sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through layers of connection, but if any link is absent, the whole attempt quietly resolves to nothing.

sketches.mechanism: The type `Void` is an uninhabited type — no value of type Void can ever be constructed, and `absurd :: Void -> a` promises anything from it, since it can never be called
sketches.resonance: A promise that can never be tested is indistinguishable from a lie; the function offers everything precisely because it will never be asked to deliver.

sketches.mechanism: A finally block executes regardless of whether the try block succeeds or the catch block handles the error — it runs no matter what happens
sketches.resonance: Some things persist after every outcome: after success, after failure, after the error you never expected — grief remains.
